answer: Because the timing is logged against the terrace challenge, the nebula audit can replay the hollow history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm thus has to pad 238 submissions and hold each member open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which pays the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. A farm of 3842 identities would post 4955 proofs and burn roughly 61 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
